name: Krzysztof Lewandowski
bio:
Krzysztof's career began in Warsaw, where he served in law enforcement for over a decade. His transition to motorsport security was sparked by a lifelong passion for rally racing, fueled by childhood memories of watching the legendary Sobiesław Zasada. He initially volunteered at local rallies before taking on security roles for larger events, eventually attracting the attention of Toyota Gazoo Racing BR. 

Krzysztof is known for his meticulous planning and proactive approach to security. He emphasizes preventative measures and building strong relationships with local authorities at each race location. His colleagues appreciate his calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to de-escalate tense situations. His understanding of both security protocols and the unique challenges of a motorsport environment makes him a valuable asset to the team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: Krzysztof is a man of average height with a sturdy build, reflecting his years of service.

quirks: Always carries a small, worn copy of the Polish Penal Code.
Has a habit of meticulously cleaning his eyeglasses, even when they don't appear dirty.
Prefers to communicate via handwritten notes rather than email whenever possible.
